title: Fix Activities tab badge filtering, add challenge persistence, implement Love Wheel physics, and add real-time sync

requirements.text: Fix badge display logic in Activities tab to properly filter and show only unlocked badges by verifying the filtering logic matches backend unlock conditions from getBadgeMilestones

quotes: Badge Display Logic Problem: The Activities tab filters badges by isUnlocked status, but the backend returns ALL milestone badges (locked and unlocked)

acceptanceCriteria: Only badges that meet unlock conditions (7-day, 30-day, 100-day streaks) are displayed
Locked badges do not appear in the badges list
Badge unlock status correctly reflects current streak data

requirements.text: Add backend persistence for Love Challenges completion tracking so completed challenges are stored on-chain and persist across page refreshes

quotes: Challenge Completion Tracking: Love Challenges use local state (completedChallenges) but don't persist to backend

acceptanceCriteria: Completed Love Challenges are stored in stable storage
Challenge completion state persists after page refresh
Backend provides endpoint to fetch user's completed challenges

requirements.text: Connect frontend Love Challenges component to use backend persistence instead of local state for tracking completed challenges
acceptanceCriteria: LoveChallenges component fetches completed challenges from backend
Challenge completion submits to backend endpoint
Completed challenges persist across sessions

requirements.text: Implement Spin the Love Wheel with smooth deceleration physics using ease-out cubic easing, 3-5 second spin duration, and randomized final stopping angle with slight offset to avoid landing exactly on dividing lines between sections

quotes: We'd also need to make sure the Love Wheel slowly comes to a stop and doesn't always land right on a line in between two
Add a realistic 'spin down' animation using easing functions (ease-out cubic)

acceptanceCriteria: Wheel spins with gradual deceleration over 3-5 seconds
Final stopping position uses randomized offset to avoid landing on dividing lines
Animation uses ease-out cubic easing for natural feel
Slight bounce effect occurs when wheel stops

requirements.text: Add real-time polling or data refresh mechanism for Activities tab to automatically sync badges, streaks, and challenge data when partner completes rituals without requiring manual page refresh

quotes: Missing Real-Time Sync: Activities tab doesn't auto-refresh when partner completes a ritual

acceptanceCriteria: Activities tab automatically refreshes data at regular intervals
Streak counter updates when partner completes rituals
Badge unlocks appear without manual refresh
Challenge progress reflects partner activity in real-time

requirements.text: Add visual feedback in Activities tab showing progress toward next badge unlock with message like '3 days until next badge!'

quotes: Add visual feedback when badges are close to unlocking ('3 days until next badge!')

acceptanceCriteria: Display shows days remaining until next badge milestone
Message updates dynamically based on current streak
Visual indicator is prominent and easy to understand

constraints: All backend logic must remain in the single main actor file (backend/main.mo)

Do not modify immutable frontend paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui
nonGoals: Implementing push notifications for partner activity
Adding WebSocket support for real-time updates
Removing the Spin the Love Wheel feature
